summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with product/order/user-profile types and a new React storefront/admin UI with cart, checkout flow, TanStack Router, and neutral Tailwind theme. Several key acceptance criteria are either not evidenced or appear contradicted (product fetch by slug, guest checkout, admin active/inactive product status, and “no blue/purple palette”).

missing_requirements.requirement: Checkout/order placement should work for customers without requiring login beyond admin Internet Identity.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend `placeOrder` is guarded by `AccessControl.hasPermission(... #user)` and traps if not a user; the BuildRequest explicitly lists customer accounts/login as a non-goal (beyond admin Internet Identity).
evidence: backend/main.mo (placeOrder: "Unauthorized: Only users can place orders")
BuildRequest Non-goals: "Customer accounts/login (beyond admin Internet Identity)"

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query method to fetch a single product by ID/slug.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend shows `getProduct(id : Nat)` only; no slug field/type or `getProductBySlug`-style API is evidenced in the diff summary.
evidence: backend/main.mo (Product type has id/name/price/description/image; `getProduct(id : Nat)` only)

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin can set and manage product active/inactive status and archive products (deactivate) without deleting historical orders.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend admin product form has no active/inactive field; and `isArchived` is hardcoded to always return `false` with a comment that backend doesn't expose archive status, so archiving state cannot be reflected/managed correctly from the UI as evidenced.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPage.tsx (`isArchived(...) { return false; // Backend doesn't expose archive status directly }`)

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply an industrial theme with no blue/purple palette.
missing_requirements.reason: Admin order status badge colors explicitly use blue and purple for statuses (processing/shipped), which conflicts with the “no blue/purple palette” constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management APIs (get/save user profiles) with role-based access control.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on product catalog + checkout customer contact info capture; it does not request persistent user profiles or profile APIs, and explicitly lists customer accounts/login as a non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin access-control initialization via a secret URL parameter `caffeineAdminToken` and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies Internet Identity for admin access and owner/allowlist enforcement; it does not request a secret-token bootstrap mechanism via URL parameters.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes social media icons/links and a promotional “Built with caffeine.ai” link.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of requested storefront/catalog/checkout/admin functionality; adds unrelated marketing/external links.
